statement: The circle-action lift constructs the universal cover of SL2(R) and the determinant-signed extension of GL2(R) with determinant plus or minus one.
notes: Explicit pairs of a matrix and a lift of its normalized circle action; reflection conjugates the deck generator to its inverse.

statement: The positive integral lifted group is B3; its centre maps to minus I and its centre-square is the kernel over SL2(Z).
notes: Tietze transformations, modular free product, and lifted rotation identify the exact quotient and sign. A braid relation check alone is not used as a presentation proof.

statement: The special torus group is the lifted GL2(Z), namely B3 semidirect C2 with reflection a↦b^-1 and b↦a^-1.
notes: Derivative map and contractibility of the marked torus identity component; two equivalent reflection presentations; boundary-fixed and tangent-lift conventions distinguished.

statement: Three literal normalization formulas require corrections: normalize by |u(z)|, change the lift shift to (2n,-3n), and use reflection t↦1/4-t.
notes: Actual scans 232–233 inspected; each correction follows from the typed target and a direct calculation. Scan 231 half-turn/full-turn ambiguity is explained.

statement: The early draft question-mark extension is B3 over SL2(Z) with class 1 under the negative-kernel convention of later scans 35–36; the opposite convention gives class 5.
notes: Images 20,27,29 inspected; original archive PDF retrieved and images 35–36 directly inspected. Visible negative exponent and displayed lifts consistently give class 1. Both sign conventions computed; overwritten prime labels are not needed to fix the presentation.

statement: The standard profinite GT braid action is a↦a^lambda, b↦f(a²,b²)^-1 b^lambda f(a²,b²), with z↦z^lambda.
notes: Primary formulas and operadic coherence opened; inverse GT element proves invertibility. This is the standard braid base point.

statement: For actual peripheral-line-preserving automorphisms of the profinite free group of rank two, the normalizer of Bhat3 is a split extension of GT-hat by Bhat3.
manuscript_passages: C4 §53, scans 222–227; normalizer comparison with LM3 E.10
notes: Peripheral centralizer and normalizer proved; Ferrari sequence and characteristic kernel verified; strict fixing of c instead gives GT1. Based normalizer is not confused with the outer quotient.

statement: The Tate–Weierstrass arithmetic section has the Kummer correction a^-8rho2 on the second braid generator; its quotient is G_Q, not asserted equal to GT-hat.
notes: Full based correction is a^-8rho2 z^4rho2. The half-twist change of free basis aligns Nakamura tau1,tau2 with the A,B convention used in Part D.

statement: All charming GT-shadows in the pure-abelian compatible braid quotients with |Q3(m)|≤1000 are listed and genuine; separate congruence matrix candidates are audited without being called shadows.
manuscript_passages: C4 §53 action formulas; prompt E(d) computational request
notes: Executed m=1,…,5, giving 13 genuine shadows; all cyclic quotients through order 1000 and 304192 power automorphisms checked. Matrix moduli 2,…,10 yield the stated candidate/descent counts. This initial family calculation is supplemented by the exhaustive quotient audit in E.14–E.17.

statement: Covering germs of a punctured surface are Z-sets, their finite part is finite continuous Zhat-sets, and tangent rays give the stated geometric and profinite transport torsors.
notes: Explicit polar universal-cover construction proves arbitrary-cover descent for this cofinal disk system; no uniform descent theorem for arbitrary spaces is assumed. Smooth-divisor and normal-crossing local models also proved.

statement: The literal inverse 2-limit of the full small topoi of shrinking punctured disks is degenerate; the covering-germ topos is instead BZ.
manuscript_passages: C4 scans 242–243, fols. 768′–769, parenthetical topos proposal
notes: A cone forces every exterior annulus to pull back to zero although their union is terminal. Explicit small-site replacement and pro-topos alternative given. Manuscript good-case qualification retained.

statement: For hyperbolic marked compact surfaces the differential and topological lifted actions have the same special component extension; the low-type exceptions have smaller or absent tangent kernels.
depends_on: Hatcher2022Torus, Theorem B and Handle Smoothing Theorem
notes: Primary theorem texts opened. Weak contractibility suffices on Homeo; Frechet ANR argument gives actual contractibility on Diff. Explicit derivative homotopy and (0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,0) calculations. Component comparison is justified separately by smoothing and cut-graph isotopies.

statement: Literal equality of topological and differentiable germ groups and unrestricted simply connected ordinary-point covering germs are false.
notes: Radial and spiral homeomorphism germs give explicit counterexamples; a convergent sequence with infinitely many sheets refutes full faithfulness. Finite-cover and locally connected surface corrections are proved.

statement: All 1946 marked B3 quotient kernels of order at most 1000 are enumerated; exact hexagons and groupoid source kernels are checked for every finite candidate.
manuscript_passages: C4 §53 action formulas; prompt E(d) numerical request
notes: 1000 cyclic and 946 noncyclic kernels; 471 inside PB3; 255167 noncyclic candidates, 100055 two-hexagon pairs, 89721 H-surjective pairs, 72251 self-kernel pairs; 19147 eligible gentle shadows. All pair counts and source kernels saved.

statement: Every bounded finite pair is the projection of a charming full-GT shadow on the explicitly declared forgetful arity-four target, whose arity-three kernel is the linking refinement K°.
manuscript_passages: C4 §53 action formulas; prompt E(d) finite-shadow scope
notes: K°=(K∩PB3)∩ker(link mod N_ord), index 6|H-prime|N_ord^3. All 20 deletion/cabling composites and 4 pentagon coordinates verified. 393913 projected pairs; 8 unchanged kernels; 40 refinements stay≤1000; maximum refined order 5982017994. Source kernel is refined separately. Exact original conductor and projected-shadow conventions are distinct.

statement: Class-two braid images are determined exactly by the cyclotomic coefficient (chi²−1)/24; 180 finite shadows on 10 eligible kernels are fake, with an explicit order 486 example and a full arity-four fake refinement.
manuscript_passages: C4 §53; prompt E(d) distinction between finite shadows and genuine images
notes: Global coefficient is derived before reduction in the torsion-free completed class-two free group. Exact full GT, GT0 and G_Q images for 1000 cyclic and 354 noncyclic quotients. Independent 54-point permutations prove the order 486 fake pair (m=0,f=[X,Y]); actual PB4 target order 3^13 and induced PB3 quotient 3^7 verified. 592 noncyclic genuine images remain unspecified.

statement: The actual published DLL targets N0,N1,N2 have their full practical/charming shadow sets independently enumerated and their pentagons verified.
manuscript_passages: C4 §53 action formulas; prompt E(d) literature examples
notes: PB4 orders 8, 8, 12; B3 orders 192, 192, 648; practical counts 4, 8, 18; charming counts 4, 4, 6. All charming shadows of N0/N1 are genuine. Both first targets induce the same kernel 315, but practical-shadow sets differ. The four extra charming shadows of N2 are not declared genuine.
